# Documentation

Applies to participant-facing prose, excluding facilitator-only areas. Use UK English, short factual statements, source paths for behaviour claims, and explicit confidence/assumptions. Do not reveal facilitator-only issue answers in participant docs. Verify relative links and keep baseline docs intentionally incomplete unless asked to update them. Record doc-impact and review evidence when business rules are changed.
